title: 春天的野餐
synopsis: 妈妈带宝宝到公园野餐，宝宝发现风吹动树叶，两人分享食物并开心回家。

bible.mood: warm, gentle, healing; soft golden light

characters.brief: a woman in her thirties with long dark hair and a beige cardigan
a four-year-old girl with short black hair and a yellow dress

scenes.description: a sunlit city-park lawn in late morning, soft shadows under old maple trees, calm breeze

props.description: a red and white checkered picnic blanket spread on the grass

segments.endState: the girl stands on the blanket holding a fallen leaf up to the sun, the mother sits beside her smiling, medium-wide framing, soft golden light
segments.plot: 公园里铺开野餐垫，宝宝追逐飘落的树叶。
segments.cameraNotes: 广角建立场景后跟拍宝宝

segments.endState: the two sit close together on the blanket sharing fruit, both smiling, medium shot, warm afternoon light
segments.plot: 同一片草地上，两人分享水果并相视而笑。
segments.cameraNotes: 从手部特写缓慢拉到双人中景
